critical.about: AGENTS.md Change Criticality: contract source and release tooling, and Shared code that signs, sends a transaction, moves funds, or changes auth, session or queue state. scripts/data/validation-policy.json criticalOverrides is authoritative: the check selector also escalates every Shared file its exact list names and any file that reaches a sharedMutationPrimitives call. The owner reviews and merges; never auto-merged.

sensitive.about: AGENTS.md Change Criticality and Essential rules: agent runtime, indexer lifecycle, plan evidence, validation and migration tooling, admin workflow state, client journeys, read-only Shared hooks, and manifests, lockfiles, CI, agent instructions and harness configuration. routine.about: Everything else: documentation, stories, cleanup and test-only refactors without runtime changes. Auto-merges once CI Gate is green.
